geometry_edits: Replaced legacy 44-node OSM-derived massing footprint with the 20-vertex named Purdue GIS feature 253 outline.
Extruded the exact source plan to four above-grade stories; 3.8 m floor spacing and total height are estimates.
Added repeated red-brick facade bays, pale window frames, horizontal stone courses, dark low roof/cornice, and a modest columned porch based on available qualitative references.
Preserved asset ID, object name, collection name, campus-coordinate frame, identity object transform, and manifest asset path.
uncertainties: GIS positional accuracy is unpublished; it is not a survey.
Official GIS count is 5 levels but OSM says 4 and GIS level-code fields are incomplete; 4 above-grade modeled levels and height remain uncertain.
Roof form and exact height have no reliable elevation source; height is estimated.
One official exterior image shows only one facade/courtyard view; window dimensions and all other elevations remain unverified.
Main entrance orientation is inferred from street/address context, not a compass-tagged plan.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence

findings: All 20 GIS structural wall edges matched within 0.000031 m; OSM centroid is 0.66 m from GIS centroid.
Purdue GIS reports five levels while OSM and the model indicate four; model wall height (15.2 m) and roof top (15.65 m) are estimates, with roof form unverified.
East-facing entrance bearing is inferred. The modeled canopy reads smaller and more isolated than the Purdue description of a large main-entrance porch.
Purdue GIS positional accuracy is unpublished; unpictured facades and precise window/porch dimensions remain unverified.
